title: Computationally Designed RNA Aptamers Enable Selective Detection of FUS Pathology in ALS
authors: Zacco E; Gilodi M; Dos Santos A; Armaos A; James R; Di Palma F; Waldron FM; Scotto M; Rupert J; Korobeynikov V; Shneider NA; Horrocks MH; Gregory JM; Tartaglia GG
one_liner_zh: 该文设计RNA适体检测FUS蛋白病理聚集，虽涉及RNA-蛋白互作，但非TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟建模方法，仅实验应用，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

FUS is an RNA/DNA-binding protein whose mislocalization and aggregation are defining pathological features of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD). Detecting pathological FUS assemblies remains challenging, as antibody-based approaches are frequently limited by epitope masking, conformational heterogeneity, and cross-reactivity with physiological FUS pools. Here we apply rationally designed RNA aptamers to selectively recognize FUS across soluble and aggregated states. The aptamers bind solvent-exposed RNA-binding regions of FUS with low-nanomolar affinity and adopt stable hairpin conformations that support high specificity. In cultured cells expressing the ALS-associated p.P525L FUS mutation, the aptamers detect cytoplasmic and nuclear FUS assemblies that are frequently missed by commercial antibodies and show reduced recognition of FUS-containing protein complexes. Using super-resolution imaging, the aptamers enable visualization of early FUS aggregation intermediates that are inaccessible to conventional amyloid dyes. In post-mortem brain tissue from individuals with FUS-ALS, aptamer staining selectively labels pathological FUS while sparing normal nuclear FUS, revealing prominent nuclear and nucleolar pathology that is poorly resolved by antibody-based methods. Together, these findings establish RNA aptamers as sensitive and selective probes for pathological FUS and uncover previously underappreciated features of FUS aggregation in ALS. This work highlights the value of nucleic-acid–based recognition tools for interrogating protein misfolding and neurodegenerative disease pathology.
abstract_zh:
摘要

FUS是一种RNA/DNA结合蛋白，其错误定位和聚集是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）和额颞叶变性（FTLD）的典型病理特征。检测病理性FUS聚集体仍具挑战性，因为基于抗体的方法常受限于表位掩蔽、构象异质性以及与生理性FUS库的交叉反应。在此，我们应用合理设计的RNA适体（RNA aptamers）选择性识别可溶性和聚集状态的FUS。这些适体以低纳摩尔亲和力结合FUS的溶剂暴露RNA结合区域，并采用稳定的发夹构象以支持高特异性。在表达ALS相关p.P525L FUS突变的培养细胞中，适体可检测到商业抗体常遗漏的细胞质和核内FUS聚集体，并显示出对含FUS蛋白复合物的识别减弱。利用超分辨成像，适体能够可视化传统淀粉样染料无法触及的早期FUS聚集中间体。在FUS-ALS患者死后脑组织中，适体染色选择性标记病理性FUS，同时保留正常核内FUS，揭示出基于抗体方法难以分辨的显著核和核仁病理。综上，这些发现确立了RNA适体作为病理性FUS的敏感且选择性探针，并揭示了ALS中FUS聚集此前未被充分认识的特征。这项工作凸显了基于核酸的识别工具在探究蛋白质错误折叠和神经退行性疾病病理中的价值。
